name: bedrock-multi-model-mcp

tools.name: bedrock_ask
tools.description: Send a prompt to any AWS Bedrock model via the Converse API. Supports Claude, GPT, Grok, Kimi, Gemma, Mistral, Nova, Qwen, DeepSeek, and more. Use short aliases (e.g. 'claude-sonnet', 'nova-pro') or full model IDs, or pass level instead of model to use the first model of that level. Pass schema to get JSON that matches it, and effort to set the thinking depth. files: Optional local text files to include in the prompt, read only from under the root folder (env BEDROCK_MCP_FILES_ROOT, default the server's working folder unless that is a home folder or a drive root): up to 10 files, 256 KB each and 1 MB in total, secret-looking files such as .env and keys and network paths are refused, and the content is sent to the model provider. A refused file fails the call before any model is billed. Optional conversation_id turns on a follow-up conversation: earlier turns of the same id are sent along as context. It is kept in memory only, forgotten 30 minutes after the last turn or when the server restarts, holds at most 20 turns, and the id is 1 to 64 letters, digits, "-" or "_". Attached file contents are kept with their turn and sent again on each follow-up, to whichever model that follow-up names. The reply header shows the tokens and an estimated cost from list prices.

model.description: Model alias (e.g. 'claude-opus', 'kimi', 'mistral-large', 'nova-pro', 'deepseek') or full Bedrock model ID. Required unless level is given; model and level together is an error.

level.description: Use the first model of a level instead of model: cheap (Nova Micro, Ministral 3 14B, Qwen3 Next 80B A3B); medium (Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Mistral Large 3 (675B)); intense (Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6.2 Astra, Grok 4.7).

prompt.description: The user prompt to send to the model

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0-1, default 0.7). Ignored by models that don't support it.

effort.description: Thinking depth and token spend for models that take it (Claude except Haiku 4.5, GPT-6.x, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, Gemma 4 up to xhigh): low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Claude Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 default to medium. bedrock_ask rejects it for other models; bedrock_compare, bedrock_judge and bedrock_panel apply it only to the models that take it.

schema.description: JSON schema the reply must match (structured output). Object schemas need additionalProperties: false. Supported by Claude, GPT-6.x, GPT-OSS, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, Gemma 4, Mistral Large 3, Ministral 3, Qwen3, DeepSeek V3.2, MiniMax M2.5 and Nemotron 3 Super; not by Nova, Pixtral or Magistral Small.

files.description: Local text file paths, relative to the files root (BEDROCK_MCP_FILES_ROOT or the server's working folder). Each file is appended to the prompt and its content is sent to the model provider.

conversation_id.description: Follow-up conversation id (1-64 letters, digits, '-' or '_'); omit for a one-off call. See the tool description.

tools.name: bedrock_compare
tools.description: Send the same prompt to multiple Bedrock models and compare responses side by side. Useful for evaluating model quality, speed, and style differences. Pass level instead of models for a default set of three: cheap (Nova Micro, Ministral 3 14B, Qwen3 Next 80B A3B); medium (Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Mistral Large 3 (675B)); intense (Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6.2 Astra, Grok 4.7); models wins when both are given. files: Optional local text files to include in the prompt, read only from under the root folder (env BEDROCK_MCP_FILES_ROOT, default the server's working folder unless that is a home folder or a drive root): up to 10 files, 256 KB each and 1 MB in total, secret-looking files such as .env and keys and network paths are refused, and the content is sent to the model provider. A refused file fails the call before any model is billed. Each answer shows its tokens and an estimated cost from list prices, with the total at the end.

models.description: List of 2-5 model aliases or IDs to compare (e.g. ['kimi', 'nova-pro', 'mistral-large']). Required unless level is given.

level.description: Default models when models is absent: cheap (Nova Micro, Ministral 3 14B, Qwen3 Next 80B A3B); medium (Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Mistral Large 3 (675B)); intense (Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6.2 Astra, Grok 4.7). Ignored when models is given.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to all models

system.description: Optional system prompt sent to all models

effort.description: Thinking depth and token spend for models that take it (Claude except Haiku 4.5, GPT-6.x, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, Gemma 4 up to xhigh): low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Claude Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 default to medium. bedrock_ask rejects it for other models; bedrock_compare, bedrock_judge and bedrock_panel apply it only to the models that take it.

schema.description: JSON schema the reply must match (structured output). Object schemas need additionalProperties: false. Supported by Claude, GPT-6.x, GPT-OSS, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, Gemma 4, Mistral Large 3, Ministral 3, Qwen3, DeepSeek V3.2, MiniMax M2.5 and Nemotron 3 Super; not by Nova, Pixtral or Magistral Small.

files.description: Local text file paths, relative to the files root (BEDROCK_MCP_FILES_ROOT or the server's working folder). Each file is appended to the prompt and its content is sent to the model provider.

tools.name: bedrock_judge
tools.description: Send the same prompt to 2-5 Bedrock models, then have a judge model (default Claude Opus) score the answers blind - shuffled and labeled A/B/C with model names hidden - and pick a winner. Set synthesize to also get one merged answer that keeps the best of each. Pass level instead of models for three default candidates: cheap (Nova Micro, Ministral 3 14B, Qwen3 Next 80B A3B); medium (Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Mistral Large 3 (675B)); intense (Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6.2 Astra, Grok 4.7); models wins when both are given, and level never changes the judge. files: Optional local text files to include in the prompt, read only from under the root folder (env BEDROCK_MCP_FILES_ROOT, default the server's working folder unless that is a home folder or a drive root): up to 10 files, 256 KB each and 1 MB in total, secret-looking files such as .env and keys and network paths are refused, and the content is sent to the model provider. A refused file fails the call before any model is billed. The files reach the candidates and the judge. The report ends with an estimated cost from list prices for the answers plus the judge call.

models.description: List of 2-5 candidate model aliases or IDs (e.g. ['kimi', 'nova-pro', 'deepseek']). Required unless level is given.

level.description: Default candidates when models is absent: cheap (Nova Micro, Ministral 3 14B, Qwen3 Next 80B A3B); medium (Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Mistral Large 3 (675B)); intense (Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6.2 Astra, Grok 4.7). Ignored when models is given; not the judge.

criteria.description: What the judge scores on (default 'correctness, completeness, clarity and concision')

synthesize.description: Also return one merged final answer (default false)

system.description: Optional system prompt sent to the candidates

effort.description: Thinking depth and token spend for models that take it (Claude except Haiku 4.5, GPT-6.x, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, Gemma 4 up to xhigh): low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Claude Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 default to medium. bedrock_ask rejects it for other models; bedrock_compare, bedrock_judge and bedrock_panel apply it only to the models that take it.

files.description: Local text file paths, relative to the files root (BEDROCK_MCP_FILES_ROOT or the server's working folder). Each file is appended to the prompt and its content is sent to the model provider.

tools.name: bedrock_panel
tools.description: Run a short discussion between 2-5 Bedrock models and return the transcript. Unlike bedrock_compare, the models answer in turn and each one sees what the earlier ones said, so they can agree, push back and build on each other. Give each model a role (critic, builder, fact-checker, devils-advocate, simplifier, moderator, or your own words), run 1-3 rounds, and set summarize to a model that closes with where the panel agrees and disagrees. Pass level instead of models for a default panel of three: cheap (Nova Micro, Ministral 3 14B, Qwen3 Next 80B A3B); medium (Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Mistral Large 3 (675B)); intense (Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6.2 Astra, Grok 4.7). Turns run one after another and each is billed: models x rounds generations, plus one for the summary. A model that fails loses its turn and the panel carries on. files: Optional local text files to include in the prompt, read only from under the root folder (env BEDROCK_MCP_FILES_ROOT, default the server's working folder unless that is a home folder or a drive root): up to 10 files, 256 KB each and 1 MB in total, secret-looking files such as .env and keys and network paths are refused, and the content is sent to the model provider. A refused file fails the call before any model is billed. The files are part of the question every turn sees. The totals line gives an estimated cost from list prices for the turns plus the summary.

prompt.description: The question or task the panel discusses

models.description: 2-5 model aliases or IDs, in speaking order (e.g. ['nova-pro', 'kimi', 'deepseek']). Required unless level is given. A model may be listed twice only with different roles.

roles.description: One entry per model, in the same order: a preset (critic, builder, fact-checker, devils-advocate, simplifier, moderator), free text up to 200 characters, or null for no role

rounds.description: Rounds of discussion, 1-3 (default 1). In round 2 and 3 each model answers again having seen everything so far.

summarize.description: Model alias or ID that closes with a short summary of where the panel agrees and disagrees. It is told it is the moderator and is not a panelist unless it is also in models.

level.description: Default panel when models is absent: cheap (Nova Micro, Ministral 3 14B, Qwen3 Next 80B A3B); medium (Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-6 Luna, Mistral Large 3 (675B)); intense (Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6.2 Astra, Grok 4.7). Ignored when models is given.

effort.description: Thinking depth and token spend for models that take it (Claude except Haiku 4.5, GPT-6.x, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3, Gemma 4 up to xhigh): low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Claude Opus 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 default to medium. bedrock_ask rejects it for other models; bedrock_compare, bedrock_judge and bedrock_panel apply it only to the models that take it.

files.description: Local text file paths, relative to the files root (BEDROCK_MCP_FILES_ROOT or the server's working folder). Each file is appended to the prompt and its content is sent to the model provider.

tools.name: bedrock_list_models
tools.description: List available Bedrock text models with their aliases, providers, use cases, and capabilities. Filter by provider name if needed.

tools.name: bedrock_doctor
tools.description: Check which Bedrock text models work on this AWS account right now. Sends one small billed call (a one-word prompt, at most 32 output tokens) to each model: every registry text model (35) by default, or only the models passed. Returns a table with one status per model: ok (answered), throttled (rate or quota limit right now; try again later), denied (no model access or not authorized on this account), invalid (unknown model id, not in the registry, or not offered in this region), error (anything else; see the note).

models.description: Model aliases or IDs to check (default every text model in the registry); a repeated model is checked once

concurrency.description: Models checked at the same time, 1-8 (default 4)

tools.name: bedrock_generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using AWS Bedrock image models (Stable Image Ultra, Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, Stable Image Core). Saves the image to the current working directory by default (or output_dir if passed, or BEDROCK_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR env var, falling back to ~/bedrock-images/ if cwd is not writable).

model.description: Image model alias: 'stable-ultra' (default, best quality), 'sd3.5', 'stable-core' (fastest/cheapest), or a full model ID

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

negative_prompt.description: What to exclude from the image (e.g. 'blurry, low quality')

width.description: Desired width (default 1024). Stability models take an aspect ratio, not pixel dimensions: width and height only pick the closest supported ratio (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 3:2, 2:3, 4:5, 5:4, 21:9, 9:21) and the model chooses the output pixels. The reported size is measured from the saved PNG.

height.description: Desired height (default 1024). See `width` - only the resulting aspect ratio is sent.

output_dir.description: Directory to save the image. Absolute or relative to cwd. Auto-created if missing. Overrides BEDROCK_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR and default resolution.

tools.name: bedrock_edit_image
tools.description: Edit or transform a local image with Stability AI Image Services on AWS Bedrock: fill or erase a masked area, extend the canvas, swap or recolor an object found by a prompt, remove the background, upscale, draw from a sketch or structure, or apply a style. Saves the result as a PNG, like bedrock_generate_image.

operation.description: What to do: inpaint (needs prompt); outpaint (needs one of left/right/up/down); erase; remove-background; search-replace (needs prompt, search_prompt); search-recolor (needs prompt, select_prompt); upscale-fast; upscale-conservative (needs prompt); upscale-creative (needs prompt); control-sketch (needs prompt); control-structure (needs prompt); style-guide (needs prompt); style-transfer (needs style_image_path)

image_path.description: Input image (PNG, JPEG or WebP), absolute or relative to cwd. For style-transfer, the image to restyle.

negative_prompt.description: What to keep out of the output

mask_path.description: inpaint, erase: black-and-white mask image, white where the image should change. Without it, the input image's alpha channel is used as the mask.

style_image_path.description: style-transfer: the image whose style is applied

search_prompt.description: search-replace: the object to find and replace

select_prompt.description: search-recolor: the object to find and recolor

left.description: outpaint: pixels to add on the left

right.description: outpaint: pixels to add on the right

up.description: outpaint: pixels to add on top

down.description: outpaint: pixels to add at the bottom

creativity.description: upscale-conservative and upscale-creative (0.1-0.5), outpaint (0.1-1): how much new detail to invent

control_strength.description: control-sketch, control-structure: how closely the output follows the input (default 0.7)

grow_mask.description: inpaint, erase, search-replace, search-recolor: pixels to grow and soften the mask edge (default 5)

fidelity.description: style-guide: how closely the output follows the input image's style (default 0.5)

composition_fidelity.description: style-transfer: how closely the output keeps the input's composition (default 0.9)

style_strength.description: style-transfer: how strongly the style image applies (default 1)

change_strength.description: style-transfer: how much the input may change (default 0.9)

style_preset.description: Style preset, for the operations that take one

output_format.description: Result file format (default png; webp for the three upscale operations, whose PNG is over Bedrock's 16 MB response limit)

output_dir.description: Directory to save the image, as in bedrock_generate_image (BEDROCK_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR, cwd or ~/bedrock-images)

tools.name: bedrock_generate_video
tools.description: Start a video generation job using Luma Ray 2 on AWS Bedrock. Videos are generated asynchronously and saved to an S3 bucket. Returns a job ARN - use bedrock_video_status to check progress. Note: the output S3 bucket must be in us-west-2 (the model region). Pass start_image_path and/or end_image_path to turn local images into the first and last frame (image-to-video); the images are checked before the job is started.

model.description: Video model alias: 'luma-ray' / 'ray2' (default), or a full model ID

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate

s3_uri.description: S3 URI for output (e.g. 's3://my-bucket/videos/'). Bucket must be in the model's region.

duration_seconds.description: Video duration in seconds: 5 (default) or 9. Luma Ray 2 supports no other value.

start_image_path.description: Local JPEG or PNG used as the first frame (512x512 to 4096x4096 pixels), absolute or relative to cwd

end_image_path.description: Local JPEG or PNG used as the last frame (512x512 to 4096x4096 pixels), absolute or relative to cwd

tools.name: bedrock_video_status
tools.description: Check the status of a Bedrock video generation job (Luma Ray 2). Returns status (InProgress, Completed, Failed) and output location.

invocation_arn.description: The job ARN returned by bedrock_generate_video

tools.name: bedrock_embed_similarity
tools.description: Embed 2 or more texts with an AWS Bedrock embedding model (Amazon Titan, Cohere) and return a cosine-similarity matrix. Scores range 0 (unrelated) to 1 (identical meaning). Useful for semantic search, deduplication, and clustering. Pass images (local JPEG or PNG paths) beside or instead of texts to compare images with each other and with texts; that needs a multimodal model ('titan-multimodal' or 'cohere'). At least 2 inputs in total.

texts.description: List of up to 50 texts to embed and compare pairwise

images.description: Local JPEG or PNG paths (absolute or relative to cwd) to embed beside the texts; rows and columns show the file name

model.description: Embedding model alias: 'titan-v2' (default), 'titan-multimodal', 'cohere' (Embed v4), or a full model ID
